name: Round Table
description: SYNAPSE — Multi-model debate via RAAC protocol with cognitive diversity scoring. Makes cheap models smarter than expensive ones.

speakerSelectionMode.description: 7A: who drives role assignment. 'builtin' = greedy bipartite match; 'ag2-hook' = external speaker-selection hook (falls back to builtin if absent); 'auto' = external if present else builtin.

roleModels.description: 7B: per-role model overrides (role -> 'provider/model'). Precedence: roleModels[role] > builtin ROLE_MODEL[role] > FALLBACK_MODEL. Lets a cloner keep cross-provider diversity on their own catalog.

enforceProviderDiversity.description: 7C: when true, guarantee at most one participant per resolved provider (greedily drop the lowest-affinity duplicate). The selected set may shrink to the provider count.
